issues: This is an accreditation scope for an INSPECTION BODY (орган инспекции), not a testing laboratory: the table has no показатель/диапазон/единица columns, so range_from/range_to/unit are null on every row. Column mapping used: object=Наименование объекта, okpd2_code=Код ОК, tnved_code=Код ТН ВЭД ЕАЭС, indicator=Вид или тип инспекции и документы (col.5, includes any ТР ТС/ТР ЕАЭС references listed in that cell), norm_doc=Документы, устанавливающие методы инспекции (col.6). The document lists the same 5 objects twice under two different inspection-site addresses (г. Псков, ул. Гоголя, д.21-21а, пом.1001 and д.17-19, пом.1001); both full sets of rows are included and the applicable address is appended in raw_row_text in brackets for disambiguation, but is not a real field value. No ТР ТС/раздел section-heading rows exist above any row (only address lines and one 'Инспекция типа А...' scope-type heading on page 1, which per the rules are not treated as tr_section), so tr_section is null throughout. No rotated or illegible pages; page 1 is a title/signature page with no data rows and is counted as read.
